BiblicalUsage: Jishpah is Ispah, an Israelite, a son of Beriah of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles 8:16, Ispah, and Joha.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ispah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
